seo.overview.title: Travel price comparison: flights, hotels, ferries, cruises
seo.overview.description: Compare live prices from more than 20 sources: flights, hotels, ferries and cruises. With final price, tax status, source status and booking link.
seo.fluege.faq.0.q: Is the price shown the final price?
seo.fluege.faq.0.a: Only if the source states it. For many fares we also show the final price including hand and checked baggage; if that information is missing, it explicitly says "not available".
seo.fluege.faq.1.a: Because a source does not provide them or is currently blocked (rate limit). The source overview shows which sources are responding and which are paused.
seo.fluege.faq.2.a: Live with every search. The prices shown apply at the moment of the query; the binding price is the one at the provider.
seo.hotels.faq.0.q: Are hotel prices per night or per stay?
seo.hotels.faq.0.a: It depends on the source. We label the price basis for every offer and do not compute our own total when the source does not provide one.
seo.hotels.faq.1.a: Every offer states this: included, not included or not documented. We only pass on what the source states.
seo.faehren.faq.0.q: Is the price per person or per cabin?
seo.faehren.faq.0.a: We state the price basis for every offer. Vehicle fares are not supported at present; any such information comes from the source.
seo.faehren.faq.1.a: Our sources currently provide no vehicle fares. Whether and at what price a car can be brought is only stated by the provider.
seo.kreuzfahrten.faq.0.q: What is included in the cruise price?
seo.kreuzfahrten.faq.0.a: Depending on the source: cabin and board meals, with taxes varying. Drinks packages, excursions and gratuities are usually extra; the source's statement is decisive.
seo.kreuzfahrten.faq.1.q: Why are some prices in USD?
seo.kreuzfahrten.faq.1.a: Because the cruise line bills in USD. We convert only with a documented exchange rate and mark it; otherwise we show the original price.
